instruction.text: Which of these dangers are caused by working on a circuit with a voltage that is too high, and which are caused by other factors?

atoms.b: It ((++is is_not)) dangerous to add too many cells to a circuit because it can cause electrocution.
A circuit that has a voltage that is ((++too_high too_low)) can cause the circuit to overheat and start a fire.
Therefore, it is very important not to add too many ((++cells wires)) to a circuit.

atoms.a: A circuit with a voltage that is too high could catch fire.
It is not dangerous to add too much voltage to a circuit.
A circuit with a voltage that is too high can cause a lightning strike.
